description: Audit one page (cvrt-seo-manager 1.18.0+, feature page_audit; refused with a clear message on an older plugin): the site fetches the page itself and analyses H1, heading order, alt texts, og:image size, JSON-LD, FAQ visibility, location node and word count. Give exactly one of post_id (published, no password, viewable post type, else 404 csm_not_public) or url (this site's host only, else 400 csm_offsite); both or neither is rejected before any request.

post_id.description: Post ID to audit (exclusive with url)

url.description: URL on this site to audit (exclusive with post_id)

name: seo_audit_page
